item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00068","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C18","C24","C05"],"selected_candidate_label":"C18","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C18 directly establishes the precise Wage Stabilization Board referral machinery used in the child, and the child expressly invokes that order. Its operative language is reproduced nearly verbatim: presidential finding that a dispute substantially threatens national defense, referral to the Board, investigation of the disputed issues, prompt reporting, and recommendations for fair and equitable settlement. C24 is a notable earlier model for the same investigation-and-recommendation sequence, while C05 concerns related wage-stabilization machinery, but neither matches the child as concretely as C18.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the dispute ... is of a character which substantially threatens the progress of national defense. Thus, in accordance with the terms of E.O. 10233, I am referring the dispute to the Wage Stabilization Board","parent_excerpt":"The President is of the opinion that the dispute is of a character which substantially threatens the progress of national defense and refers such dispute to the Board.","explanation":"The child applies C18's precise triggering finding and presidential referral mechanism."},{"child_excerpt":"asking that the Board investigate and inquire into the issues in dispute and promptly report to me with its recommendations to the parties as to fair and equitable terms of settlement","parent_excerpt":"the Board shall investigate and inquire into the issues in dispute and promptly report to the President thereon with its recommendations to the parties as to fair and equitable terms of settlement.","explanation":"This is essentially verbatim operative language from C18."},{"child_excerpt":"although full use has been made of mediation and conciliation facilities, the strike persists and is likely to persist","parent_excerpt":"any labor dispute which is not resolved by collective bargaining or by the prior full use of conciliation and mediation facilities and which threatens an interruption of work affecting the national defense","explanation":"The child's factual findings are organized to satisfy the conditions C18 established for Board jurisdiction."}]}
